newsitem.title: USA: Corrections sells 9 prisons for $308 mln.
newsitem.headline: Corrections sells 9 prisons for $308 mln.

text.p: Corrections Corp of America said Friday it sold nine prisons to CCA Prison Realty Trust for about $308 million and is leasing them back under long-term agreements.

The jail operator said it would use the proceeds to pay down debt and to develop future projects. It added CCA will lease the properties at an annual rate of 11 percent of the sales price, or about $34 million a year, in 10 to 12 year contracts.

When CCA Prison Realty went public July 15, it said it would use the offering's proceeds to buy the nine Corrections prisons. The trust said Friday it netted $412.7 million from the 21.3 million-share initial public offering and confirmed it used $308 milion to buy the prisons, five of which are located in Texas, three in Arizona and one in Kansas and Tennessee each.

It added underwriters J.C. Bradford & Co, A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc, Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc, Lehman Brothers Inc Paine Webber Inc, and Stephens Inc exercised their entire over-allotment options of 2.8 million shares.
CCA said it expected to use the remainder of the offering's proceeds to buy an additional Corrections prison and the rest for working capital and coporate purposes.
Corrections' stock traded at 42-7/16 Friday morning, up 3/4. CCA's shares traded at 29-7/8, down 5/16 but up 8-7/8 from its initial offering price of 21.
